slides.title: Fatigue hides fitness.
slides.body: You're stronger than your last session showed. Tired tissue just can't express it.

slides.title: Never taking one.
slides.body: Seven hard weeks in a row, then a tweak in week eight. Not a coincidence.

slides.title: Doing nothing at all.
slides.body: A full week on the couch and your first session back feels like a stranger's body.

slides.title: Cut volume. Keep the weight.
slides.body: Drop your sets by about 40 percent. Keep the bar close to normal. Walk out fresh.

slides.title: Warm-ups feel heavy.
slides.body: Sleep is off, your best lifts are going backwards and you're cranky by the second set.

slides.title: Plan it. Don't wait for it.
slides.body: Every 4 to 6 weeks of hard training. A deload you schedule beats one your body forces.
